notes:
Summary: Cerulean is a platform company that will embed long-form summarization, document search and reranking into their enterprise search product. They want a dedicated footprint to guarantee 99th percentile latency and predictable cost. POC scope: dedicated nodes, model tuning, rounding out SLA language.

Key technical requirements (from infra + ML leads):
- Workloads: high-throughput document reranking and multi-turn summarization; mixed short (<=128 tokens) and long (>=2048 tokens) contexts.
- Throughput targets: 300-500 queries/sec for reranking (top-k scoring, 128 tok average), 40-80 concurrent summarization requests with up to 4k effective context (they'll stream long inputs).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 40ms for reranking single-turn, p95 < 120ms; summarization p50 < 350ms for 1k output tokens, p95 < 900ms (they're flexible for long tails but want deterministic SLOs in contract).
- Cost sensitivity: committed reserved capacity to lower unit cost; target amortized cost per 1M tokens below current self-hosted baseline.

Model & tuning preferences discussed:
- Preferred base models: open weights similar to Llama2-70B / Mistral-family; willingness to evaluate Redwood-verified variants.
- Context length: need explicit support for 4k+ effective context for summarization; will test 8k too. Request quantization that preserves long-context coherency.
- Quantization: evaluate Q4_0 vs Q4_1 vs Q8 profiles. ML team emphasized QA: "We need to run quality regressions — hallucination and coherence checks before we lock a profile."
- Batching and KV cache: want conservative batching for summarization (to meet latency SLO) and aggressive continuous batching for reranking. KV cache behavior: support prefix caching across multi-turn summarization sessions; eviction policy discussions pending.

POC plan items requested by Cerulean: 
- 72h dedicated run with two capacity profiles: (A) 8x A100-80GB reserved, tuned for Latency SLOs, (B) 6x H100 reserved tuned for throughput.
- Model tuning matrix: context lengths [4096, 8192], quant profiles [Q4_0, Q4_1, Q8], batching windows [10ms, 30ms, 100ms], KV cache TTLs [session-only, 24h].
- Measurements captured: token-level latency histogram, tail analysis (p99.9), GPU utilization, memory/KV hit rate, cost per 1M tokens.
- Quality checks: eval suite of 600 prompts for summarization/regression, BLEU/ROUGE-style heuristics and manual spot checks.

Negotiation & SLA notes:
- Legal asked for example latency SLO clause: Redwood proposed p95 latency SLOs per model-route with credits for breaches and automatic fallback to a lower-cost compatible variant. Cerulean legal asked to add minimum throughput guarantees (RPS) and a clause for capacity preemption during incidents.
- Cerulean insists on runbook availability, artifact-level audit logs, and a 4-hour P1 MTTR target with escalation to a named on-call for dedicated capacity.

Open questions / risks:
- Exact reserved GPU count (cost vs safety); infra prefers H100 but ML prefers A100 for current quant profiles.
- Quantization quality: some early Q4_0 outputs showed tokenization artifacts on long-context tests. Need ML evals to pass before production cutover.
- Procurement timeline: internal finance needs 3 weeks after SOW; may push to Jan if delayed.

Next steps (agreed):
- Redwood to provision POC config A and B; provide SLO example text for legal by 2024-11-08.
- Marcus to run tuning matrix and upload perf dashboard; Emily to coordinate SOC2 artifacts.
- Follow-up sync 2024-11-13 (post-POC baseline review).
